loader_handoff.basis: Declared discovery input: an all-zero loader handoff in a free RAM gap, not a capture. X-T2 4.41 section 0 0x58b74 stores r0 at 0x7f4f8 and, when r1 is non-zero, copies 0x5c0 bytes from r1 to 0x7f4fc. 0x900000-0x9005c0 lies between section 2 (ends 0x780330) and the section table at 0x950000. Kernel entry bypasses the boot ROM.

flash_aperture.basis: Declared discovery input: the update image from its flash offset; bytes past it read erased. No flash capture exists.
